tob-0039-d7: This microfilm roll carries a slice of the Doctors’ Trial record — Nuremberg’s judgment on the Nazi doctors. The court’s record sets out the charges, the proof, and the defense. The record is vital for grasping the medical crimes of the war.
frus-1943-cairo-tehran-d7: Marshal Stalin to President Roosevelt, June 11, 1943 — Document 7. The exchange continued into June. The message is the exchange: the leaders, corresponding.
